query:
INSERT INTO deployments
                   (stack, revision_id, state, source, created_at, updated_at, source_repository,
                    source_sha, source_ref, source_run_id, source_actor, source_tag)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
               RETURNING id AS "id!: DeploymentId"
